about: Hand-labelled meetings for Open commitments. Run: swift run Freshflo --commitments-eval Benchmarks/commitments-eval.json [--runs 3] [--smart-model <id>]. Each group lists phrases that pick out the parsed items (by task text) that are one commitment; done/open name groups that a later meeting finished or did not; due gives the date the item should end up with.
